value: CORRECTION to claim.NV_never-probed-park-green-light-roster.20260901.v1, measured 2026-09-01 by executing that roster's own corrected filter end to end. The roster remains useful as a MECHANISM CENSUS; its 'never-probed' classification is UNSOUND and must not be used as a green light. THE DEFECT: the roster's method selected RECORDS lacking attributes.probed_form / attributes.axis_log, then attributed 'never-probed' to the FUNCTION those records anchor. But a function carries several attempt records from different naming families, and the mp-label-correction family that dominates the roster is precisely the family that documents no probes. Screening the record instead of the function therefore mislabels heavily-probed functions as fresh. THREE OF THE FIVE FUNCTIONS I WORKED WERE MISLABELLED, each verified with `gdlmem find --function <fn> --kind attempt`: (1) AudioEnterNextStage — the roster's flagship DIFFERS entry, 'real 4, target blt+b vs ours beq+bge' — carries THREE live records including attempt.audioenternextstage-portable-branch-pair-closure.20260831.v2, outcome CAPPED, whose axis_log already contains two of the three shapes I measured, with the same four numbers (multiset 4t->3t, count 49/50, real 13). Its residual field already named the mechanism (MWCC front-end adjacent-target goto inversion/collapse) and recorded that the only exact form ever found used prohibited inline asm. (2) LoadWorldDone carries attempt.loadworlddone-is-addr16-lo-via-r0-not-branch-shape.20260831.v1, which names my exact finding in its own TITLE, cites claim.law.addr16-lo-address-homed-via-r0-is-source-unreachable.20260831.v1 (~10 axes dead), and carries an explicit instruction: 'DO NOT PROBE either from a control-flow or decl-order lane'. I spent three probes against that veto. (3) sndFxVoiceUpdateCb carries a legacy parked cap whose unpark condition I did in fact satisfy, so only that one reopening was legitimate. COST: of eleven probes spent this run, five were redundant re-derivations of already-recorded results. ROOT CAUSE ON MY SIDE, stated so the fix is actionable rather than blamed on the roster: I followed the work order's emphasis on `gdlmem laws --query <residual signature>` (discipline 9b) and skipped `context <function>` (AGENTS 'When to query' step 1) before the first edit. The law query is signature-scoped and does NOT surface a function's own attempt records or its recorded vetoes; only `context`/`find --function` does. The two queries are not substitutes and discipline 9b must not be read as replacing step 1. MANDATORY PROCEDURE for any future roster-driven sweep: before the first edit of each member run `gdlmem find --function <fn> --kind attempt` (or `context <fn>`) and treat ANY live record with outcome parked/capped/negative as a veto regardless of what the roster says; a roster is a queue, never a clearance. SECOND, INDEPENDENT ROSTER DEFECT — the pinned list is UNDERCOUNTED. The roster's CORRECTION #1 names exactly five webfrank-pinned members; a direct grep of config/GUNE5D/webfrank.json finds THREE MORE that are roster members and are real 0 by construction: next_boss_hint and next_legend_hint (game/ui/options, composed permute+recolor rules) and calc_wizard_pos (game/ui/auxscreen). Discipline 10's screen is therefore load-bearing and the roster's own count cannot be trusted. THIRD, THE SUBSTANTIVE CENSUS RESULT, which is the part of the roster worth keeping and extending: the corrected filter's DIFFERS head is now EXHAUSTED, and its largest cluster is a single already-closed family. Of the roster's eight named DIFFERS mechanisms, fn_800C37C4 and dcsBankLoad (both '+1 addi / -1 li' around mtctr, remeasured T47/O47 real 8 and T94/O94 real 20) are members of claim.law.live-zero-copy-vs-remat-is-allocator-not-source.20260831.v1, which lists ~15 dead axes and NAMES fn_800C37C4 and InitControls explicitly; CritterProcessSafeRocks is already exact; CTriListCollide and pbSendObjTextures are claimed by the composed-harvest lane; InitControls sits in an owned TU. I extended the census with fresh `--ops` measurements over fifteen previously unmeasured roster members: SEVEN are IDENTICAL-multiset schedule-class (pbResetDiag 39/39, PlayerLoadSaveFile 71/71, setTexInfo 94/94, init_player_change 78/78, kill_player 171/171, inactivate_player 225/225, MBCameraUpdate 159/159) and are skip-by-policy; FOUR MORE are live-zero remat family and inherit that law's veto (TextHeightMLines T46/O46 '+1 addi/-1 li', fn_80054E78 T267/O267 '+1 addi/-1 li', CritterRemoveColnodeSub T77/O77 '+1 mr/-1 li', dcsVoiceUpdate T62/O62 '+1 addi/-1 mr'); and only ONE carried a genuinely distinct source-reachable mechanism, sndFxVoiceUpdateCb's indexed-vs-displacement addressing, which I worked and re-parked. PRACTICAL CONSEQUENCE FOR THE NEXT SWEEP: ranking never-probed parks by mechanism opcode is a real improvement over ranking by real, but it is insufficient on its own — the ranking must FIRST bucket rows by law-corpus family and drop rows whose family is already closed, because on this roster the live-zero remat family alone accounts for six of the DIFFERS rows. A mechanism-opcode ranking that does not screen the law corpus at RANKING time (not merely before probing) mostly re-discovers closed families.
